steps.title: Volcanic hills
steps.body: Soave lies east of Verona. Soave Classico, in the hills around Soave and Monteforte d'Alpone, has volcanic basalt and limestone soils. Soave must be at least 70% Garganega, with Trebbiano di Soave or Chardonnay. Vines are traditionally trained on pergolas, pergola veronese.

steps.title: From volume to quality
steps.body: Soave was mass-produced in the 1970s, earning a poor reputation. Producers like Pieropan and Inama showed its real potential: mineral, almond-scented, age-worthy wines. Soave Superiore DOCG requires lower yields. Since 2019, 33 UGAs, named sub-areas like Foscarino and Calvarino, can appear on labels.

steps.prompt: What must Soave contain at least 70% of?

steps.title: Recioto di Soave
steps.body: Recioto di Soave, DOCG since 1998, is a sweet wine from dried Garganega. Grapes dry for months, concentrating sugar, sometimes with noble rot. The wine is golden, honeyed and sweet, with apricot and almond, balanced by acidity.

steps.prompt: Recioto di Soave is a sweet wine made from dried grapes.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Soave Classico grows Garganega on volcanic hills
Quality rose from cheap volume to named sub-areas
Recioto di Soave is sweet, from dried grapes
